items.title: 14035 Densmore Avenue N Seattle, WA 98133
items.description: Modern Craftsmanship in a Serene North Seattle Retreat. **10-Year Rate-Lock at 4.99% Available (qualifications apply)** This striking 2-bed, 1.75-bath home showcases a masterclass in texture and design. Experience a bright, open floor plan highlighted by custom oak-toned cabinetry, quartz & stone countertops, and a designer kitchen with integrated shelving, full backsplash, and a built-in hood vent. Packed with luxury and high-end details, including soaring ceilings and clerestory windows in the primary suite, heated bathroom floors, and architectural fluted accent walls throughout. The home delivers a level of craftsmanship that is unprecedented at this price point. Outside awaits a private, fully landscaped backyard with a level paver patio and tall 6 1/2-foot fences--perfect for entertaining, pets, relaxation - you name it. This home comes with designated pad parking and a unique scooter garage, offering a versatile solution for a home gym, studio, extra storage, or home office. Tucked away in a quiet, lush residential neighborhood--but well connected. Enjoy easy access to Hwy 99, I-5, Jackson Golf Course, Twin Parks, and all the hidden gems of North Seattle dining. This is refined living at its finest + Built Green. Are you ready for a home upgrade?

items.title: 7916 Renton Avenue S Seattle, WA 98118
items.description: This 1924 Craftsman has been updated while retaining the character that made these homes special in the first place. The main floor has the classic Craftsman layout you hope to find with a welcoming living and dining room with original hardwood, cove ceiling and picture rail. A wood burning fireplace with period Batchelder tile details and built-ins completes the space.The vintage eat-in kitchen has quartz counters, freshly painted original cabinetry and new appliances, including a dishwasher. And tucked among those cabinets is a favorite detail--the built-in pie-cooling shelf and ironing board. You just don't get that in a new kitchen. Even better, the expensive stuff is done. New wiring, plumbing, water main, sewer and furnace take much of the worry out of owning a 100-year-old home. Fresh interior and exterior paint and new light fixtures complete the refresh. Downstairs adds to the home's 2097 total square feet with a high-ceiling, walk-out basement space that awaits your ideas. More bedrooms and bath? Studio? Media room? Workshop? Recreation space? Future finished living area? ADU (attached dwelling unit). There's room to imagine. The large deep NR3 Zoned lot provides room to garden and play and a possible DADU (buyer to verify). A one-car garage and generous off-street parking are an increasingly rare Seattle luxury. Plus, you can walk to the nearest LINK Othello station. All in all, this is a home with history and personality ready for its next century of memories.

items.title: 18002 B 10th Avenue NE Shoreline, WA 98155
items.description: Welcome to Grove Pointe, Greencity Development's newest boutique townhome community in the heart of Shoreline's North City neighborhood. This flexible 3-bedroom home delivers 1,606 SF of smart, light-filled living across three levels. On the entry level, a bedroom w/ its own closet and direct garage access adapts easily as a guest suite or home office. The second floor is the heart of the home: an open-concept kitchen, dining & living space designed for both easy weeknights and hosting, featuring 2-tone cabinetry, quartz counters, tile backsplash & a full stainless steel appliance package. Upstairs, the primary suite offers an ensuite bath & walk-in closet, joined by a second bedroom, a versatile bonus room & a dedicated laundry area. A ductless heat pump provides efficient heating & cooling year-round, while ceramic tile, vinyl plank flooring & double-pane windows add lasting comfort. Minutes from North City's shops, restaurants & parks, and close to the Shoreline North/185th light rail station for a car-free commute to Seattle, the University District, or SeaTac. Shoreline School District, with quick access to I-5 and 145th Street. Ask about Greencity's Tailor program to personalize select finishes before move-in. Ask about 5.25% 10 year ARM w/ Preferred Lender (terms apply).

items.title: 583 Battery Street #508N Seattle, WA 98121
items.description: Highly sought after and rarely available over-sized 2 bedroom + DEN unit with 2 private covered decks at the coveted Insignia. Unit, parking and storage are all on the same floor, so no need to use the elevator! Open flowing floorplan with spaces and places for everything and everyone. Northern orientation is great for bringing in afternoon sun. Gourmet kitchen with sleek cabinetry, gas range & quality stainless steel appliances. Flexible and private den off entry doubles as small 3rd bedroom or combined guest room/office. Custom organized closets throughout provide plenty of storage space. Unit comes with a new washer & dryer, parking spot in the secure garage and a deeded storage unit. Insignia is known for its vacation-like amenities that pamper & refresh: 2-level gym with yoga & Pilates studio. Spa with indoor swimming pool, hot tub, dry sauna & steam room. Movie theater. Helpful 24-hr concierge staff. Multiple roof-top sky lounges with the best views of the city. Pet retreat & grooming spa. Private open air resident park. Bicycle room, car wash, EV charging stations, shared garden & more! Located in the heart of South Lake Union, just steps from everywhere you want to be. Orange Theory, Fulcrum Coffee, Sushi by Scratch & Maiz in base of building. Walk to the Amazon Spheres, Pike Place Market, the waterfront, Whole Foods & several nearby dog parks.

items.title: 1017 Minor Avenue #1401 Seattle, WA 98104
items.description: A rare opportunity to own one of three penthouses at the iconic Gainsborough -- a 1930s Tudor Revival landmark perched in the heart of First Hill. This historic building offers a rare blend of old-world grandeur and elevated city living, tucked along a serene, tree-lined street in one of Seattle's most connected neighborhoods. Step off the elevator and arrive at the top floor, where your private 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse awaits. The open layout offers the opportunity to make this home your own. Expansive windows frame captivating city views from every room, filling the space with natural light and creating a seamless connection to the surrounding skyline. Residents enjoy secure entry, a rooftop deck, and a charming historic lobby. Whether you're savoring your morning coffee or unwinding at day's end, you'll appreciate the unique blend of historic charm, modern comfort, and elevated city living that only a penthouse at the Gainsborough can offer. Location is within walking distance to three large medical facilities. Great opportunity for rental investment!!!

items.title: 4411 21st Avenue SW Seattle, WA 98106
items.description: SELLER PAID 2/1 BUYDOWN!! (Terms apply*)New Price ! Modern design meets everyday livability in this thoughtfully crafted Pigeon Point residence by Shelter Homes. Set in a quiet residential enclave bordering a lush greenbelt, this home offers approximately 1,126 square feet with 2 bedrooms, 2.25 bathrooms, and an open layout designed to maximize the warm summer light. The main living level is bright and welcoming, featuring wide-plank floors and oversized windows that frame vibrant city views and invite the sun into every corner. The kitchen is both efficient and refined, showcasing quartz countertops, full-height cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances that flow seamlessly into the living and dining areas for a connected, airy feel. Upstairs, the primary bedroom serves as a calm retreat with windows that look out over the neighboring treetops and city skyline. A spa-inspired bath with a dual vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower, along with a flexible second bedroom and additional bath, provide comfort and versatility for guests or a home office. The lower level offers a convenient entry and a private patio that feels like a hidden sanctuary, ideal for morning coffee or quiet evenings nestled against the greenbelt. With the trails of Pigeon Point just steps away and local dining and transit within easy reach, this home offers a design-forward, low-maintenance lifestyle in the heart of one of West Seattle's most scenic pockets.

items.title: 906 A 28th Avenue S Seattle, WA 98144
items.description: Nova Community by GreenCity Homes is a boutique collection of modern townhomes ideally located in Leschi--where culture, connectivity, and neighborhood character come together. Now preselling, this limited release offers a rare opportunity to add your own personal touch that reflects your style. Thoughtfully designed floor plans include select homes with private off-street parking, private upper patios, designer-curated finishes, premium appliances, and spacious primary suites crafted for elevated everyday living. Ask about 5.25% 10 year ARM with Preferred Lender (terms apply). Just moments away, enjoy the green space and trail access at Judkins Park, explore cafés and dining along Jackson Street, or head to nearby Beacon Hill and Capitol Hill for an ever-evolving mix of restaurants, music, and art. With quick access to Downtown Seattle and major transit connections, Nova places you at the center of it all--offering not just a home, but a vibrant Seattle lifestyle rooted in history and designed for what's next.

items.title: 320 NE 156th Street Shoreline, WA 98155
items.description: Charming Cape Cod in a prime Shoreline location, just minutes from Light Rail and walkable to 8 parks. The inviting main floor features a cozy living room with fireplace, open kitchen, spacious family/dining area and two bedrooms, while upstairs offers a generous primary suite with private balcony, additional bedroom and full bath. Ideal indoor/outdoor living awaits out back, where the kitchen opens directly to an expansive patio and massive backyard ready for whatever life brings--entertaining, play spaces, gardening and more--with potential space for a DADU to create rental income, a guest retreat or multigenerational living. Enjoy all that vibrant Shoreline has to offer, from the Farmers Market, Art Walk and Outdoor Movie Nights to an abundance of parks and highly regarded schools. Plus, beloved neighborhood favorites like Ridgecrest Public House, the Crest Cinema and Drumlin Coffee are right nearby. A wonderful place to call home!

items.title: 906 B 28th Avenue S Seattle, WA 98144
items.description: Welcome to Nova by GreenCity Homes, a boutique collection of modern townhomes perfectly positioned in Seattle's historic and culturally rich Leschi neighborhood. Now move-in ready! Nova presents an incredible opportunity to secure a beautifully crafted home tailored for an elevated urban lifestyle. Each thoughtfully designed floor plan shines with premium appliances, designer-curated finishes, and spacious primary suites that serve as a true sanctuary. Select homes feature the added convenience of private off-street parking and expansive upper patios designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living. Ask about 5.25% 10 year ARM with Preferred Lender (terms apply). Beyond your front door, experience unmatched connectivity and neighborhood charm. Enjoy morning jogs or peaceful afternoons at nearby Judkins Park, explore the eclectic mix of local cafés and dining options along Jackson Street, or head into nearby Beacon Hill and Capitol Hill to experience the ever-evolving scene of restaurants, live music, and art. With effortless access to Downtown Seattle, major commuter routes, and the upcoming Light Rail station, Nova perfectly pairs quiet neighborhood character with seamless transit access. Come discover a home rooted in community and designed for what's next. Photos showcase the model home layout.

draft.heroMessage: Expert guidance. Sustainable solutions. Welcome to Seattle real estate with Katerina Sayles.
draft.welcomeNote: Thank you for visiting my site. As a lifelong Pacific Northwest resident and dedicated Realtor®, I bring a personal commitment to sustainability and exceptional client service. Whether you’re buying, selling, or seeking to invest in a greener future, I’m here to help you navigate Seattle’s unique real estate landscape.
draft.tagline: Real Estate with a Heart for the Environment.
draft.aboutParagraph: With deep roots in the Pacific Northwest, I’ve seen firsthand the importance of both community and environmental responsibility. My approach combines market expertise, personalized representation, and a passion for sustainable living. I hold a Green Designation and am a member of the US Green Building Council Washington and GreenResource Council, which allows me to provide specialized insight on eco-friendly homes and practices. Let’s find a property that fits your lifestyle—and your values.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking to buy or sell in Seattle? I’m just a call or email away—reach out and let’s make your next move a great one.
draft.contactLine: Ready to start your home search or have a real estate question? Contact me at 425.466.5578 or katerina@windermere.com.
draft.tone: Warm, knowledgeable, and sustainability-focused with a personal touch and local expertise.

sections.title: Attractions and activities in West Seattle
sections.body: Alki Beach Park is one of West Seattle’s most popular destinations, with its well-maintained amenities including a scenic multi-purpose trail, picnic areas, beach volleyball courts, and 2.5-mile sandy beach surrounded by picture-perfect views of the Olympic Mountains and the Puget Sound. Avid golfers can enjoy a top-quality playing experience at the West Seattle Golf Course, a public 18-hole championship golf course with a classic layout that challenges players of all skill levels.

sections.title: Attractions and activities in Greater Seattle
sections.body: Seattle has a reputation for being one of the top art cities in the world. It is, after all, the home of rock music icons like Jimi Hendrix, Nirvana, Soundgarden, the Foo Fighters, and Pearl Jam, just to name a few. And that’s precisely why you’ll find an array of concert halls, live music stages, and avant-garde performance venues scattered throughout the city. Head to this page to find the best theaters and music venues in Seattle.

sections.title: Attractions and activities in Magnolia
sections.body: Magnolia is home to Discovery Park, the city’s largest park at 534 acres. The expansive park features two miles of shoreline, vast meadows and forests, a historic lighthouse, and a network of scenic hiking trails. Magnolia Village, the neighborhood’s central hub, is a vibrant urban center filled with cafés, pubs, grocery stores, bakeries, and restaurants offering delicious cuisine from all over the world. If you have any questions about a property or the area in general, please don’t hesitate to contact me .

sections.title: A Place Like No Other
sections.body: If you were to ask Katerina what she loves about the Pacific Northwest – she would reply, “Everything.” Living here has underscored for her the importance of making environmentally-conscious decisions. As someone drawn to the beauty of the outdoors, she appreciates the Pacific Northwest for the countless amenities it has to offer. Each aspect of her home — from the breathtaking mountains, pristine waters, vast hiking trails, and natural wildlife — allows her to stay grounded and focused on what matters.

FROM THE SITE
Attractions and activities in West Seattle
Alki Beach Park is one of West Seattle’s most popular destinations, with its well-maintained amenities including a scenic multi-purpose trail, picnic areas, beach volleyball courts, and 2.5-mile sandy beach surrounded by picture-perfect views of the Olympic Mountains and the Puget Sound. Avid golfers can enjoy a top-quality playing experience at the West Seattle Golf Course, a public 18-hole championship golf course with a classic layout that challenges players of all skill levels.
FROM THE SITE
Attractions and activities in Greater Seattle
Seattle has a reputation for being one of the top art cities in the world. It is, after all, the home of rock music icons like Jimi Hendrix, Nirvana, Soundgarden, the Foo Fighters, and Pearl Jam, just to name a few. And that’s precisely why you’ll find an array of concert halls, live music stages, and avant-garde performance venues scattered throughout the city. Head to this page to find the best theaters and music venues in Seattle.
FROM THE SITE
Attractions and activities in Magnolia
Magnolia is home to Discovery Park, the city’s largest park at 534 acres. The expansive park features two miles of shoreline, vast meadows and forests, a historic lighthouse, and a network of scenic hiking trails. Magnolia Village, the neighborhood’s central hub, is a vibrant urban center filled with cafés, pubs, grocery stores, bakeries, and restaurants offering delicious cuisine from all over the world. If you have any questions about a property or the area in general, please don’t hesitate to contact me .
ABOUT
A Place Like No Other
If you were to ask Katerina what she loves about the Pacific Northwest – she would reply, “Everything.” Living here has underscored for her the importance of making environmentally-conscious decisions. As someone drawn to the beauty of the outdoors, she appreciates the Pacific Northwest for the countless amenities it has to offer. Each aspect of her home — from the breathtaking mountains, pristine waters, vast hiking trails, and natural wildlife — allows her to stay grounded and focused on what matters.
